text:
Sara: quick heads-up — ran the int8 Q6A shadow on the longform summarization suite. some prompt clusters show >35% output divergence vs fp16 golden. looks correlated with prompt overlap between the new ingestion and our existing refset. need a small triage and plan to dedupe + expand gold where it matters. @Omar @Priya can you eyeball?

Jin: :eyes: can you paste the example families? rough idea: is this paraphrase/near-dup or stage-of-dialog overlap?

Sara: short sample:
```
Prompt A: "Summarize the following transcript from a 2hr product review..."
Prompt B: "Condense this product review meeting into action items (long transcript)"
Prompt C: "Write a TL;DR for the product review thread (very long)"
```
They map to same intent but different prefixes — dedupe hashed them differently because tokenizer truncation changed after quantized tokenization in q6a-int8.

Omar: that truncation/tokenization discrepancy rings a bell. we saw similar for qbench-int4 where prefix-preservation changed. solution: run fingerprint at normalized whitespace + semantic hash (SBERT-ish) and then apply a soft-dedup threshold. I can kick off a job if we agree on thresholds.

Priya: I can run the dedupe pipeline and produce candidate merges. propose pipeline: 1) normalize (unicode, lower, remove timestamps), 2) semantic embeddings (mini-sim), 3) cluster @ 0.88 sim, 4) sample clusters > 100 for manual review. works?

Kevin: agree on manual sample. also want to flag golden candidates where q6a-int8 shows a consistent quality regression (>5 pts ROUGE-L) across the cluster — we should expand golden for those clusters to capture diversity.

Sara: sounds good. we have limited label ops budget this sprint. Omar — can you give an ETA on the dedupe run and the compute cost?

Omar: estimate: 2 v100-days for the embedding pass on the current promptbank (~1.2M prompts). will finish embedding pass in ~6 hours if I start now. cluster pass another 2 hours. total wall ~8–10h.

Priya: I'll prep a review UI export for labelops — want fields: cluster_id, top-3 exemplars, tokenized-length, model-delta-stats (ROUGE/bleu), suggested action (merge/keep/expand-golden). can put CSV in s3://redwood-curation/q6a_overlap_triage.csv

Jin: include short snippet of model outputs for the exemplar (fp16 vs int8) — context helps spot subtle instruction-following diffs.

Sara: yes please. also add a tiny eval harness: run 200 holdout longform prompts through both models and compute ROUGE-L/QA exact-match so we can triage whether divergence is quality or stylistic.

eval-bot: new qbench run queued by Sara — id qb-3925. results: https://internal.redwood/qbench/qb-3925 (csv + per-prompt diff). preliminary: mean ROUGE-L drop 3.2, but 12% of prompts show >=8 point drop.

Kevin: that 12% aligns with clusters I saw earlier. OK to prioritize clusters where >=10 prompts show >=5pt drop and cluster size > 20.

Priya: copying the plan: I'll run dedupe, produce clusters, sample top-risk clusters for manual label ops review, then we expand golden by +2 exemplars per flagged cluster. Omar: please kick embeddings now. Jin: can you add the fp16/int8 output diff snippets to the export?

Omar: started embeddings job — ETA 6h. logging: run id dedupe-3925, working on shard 0/12.

Jin: will add diffs to export. tagging @labelops for scheduling — we need ~400 review decisions this sprint.

Sara: thanks team. I'll put a short changelog in the model bring-up doc and surface the qbench link in the PR. ping here when CSV is ready. :thumbsup:

Priya: CSV path will be s3://redwood-curation/q6a_overlap_triage.csv + s3://redwood-curation/qb-3925-diffs.csv — I'll post when uploaded.

eval-bot: upload complete for qb-3925 diffs (link above).

Kevin: good. once labelops returns decisions we should run a micro-golden re-eval and call it for the canary rollout.

Sara: plan noted. moving to blockers: labelops availability and compute. otherwise proceed.

Omar: will follow up in morning with final cluster counts and cost estimate.

Priya: thanks — will stand by to export when clusters finish.
